VAR-age.why: Direct age in years (Age on December 31, 2023) at person roster level

VAR-agecat.why: Continuous age available; can be categorized into age groups for agecat

VAR-childmth.why: Child age in months can be derived for under-5s from continuous age in years

VAR-childyr.why: Child age in years for under-5s can be derived from continuous age

VAR-male.why: Gender with Male/Female codes at person roster level

VAR-marital.why: Marital status coded categorical for persons

VAR-school.why: Current education activity Yes/No indicates current enrolment

VAR-educat4.why: Highest education level attained (diploma/certificate) with detailed categories

VAR-educat5.why: Highest education level attained provides the basis for collapsing to 5-category scheme

VAR-educat7.why: Highest education level attained provides the basis for collapsing to 7-category scheme

VAR-primarycomp.why: Highest level attained includes primary-school categories, usable to infer primary completion

notes: Only age/sex/marital and education activity/attainment are present in the bindable index; no columns found for relationship-to-head, language, literacy/read-write, disability difficulty items, or years of education completed (educy).
